name: Vessa
summary: Turns brand guidelines into live animated pages: click-to-copy colors, a documented motion spec and MCP for AI clients.
description: Vessa builds brand guidelines as live web pages instead of PDFs, at one link that stays editable and updates in place. Nine sections (intro, logo, color, typography, motion, voice, moodboard, applications, assets) can be drafted from a URL by an AI over MCP, then edited in the browser; colors copy on click and motion is documented as easing and duration values.
contains: 9 guideline sections: intro, logo, color, typography, motion, voice, moodboard, applications, assets
colors copy to the clipboard when clicked
motion spec: easing curves and durations handed over as CSS or GSAP-ready values
AI drafts a guideline from a website URL or a few sentences
MCP endpoint for Claude, Claude Code and Cursor
password-protectable guidelines, updates propagate to the same link
pricing: free to build, €25.35 one-time per published brand
